claims.text: On American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 21 April 2026, Michels dated the disappearance to Friday 27 February 2026 at Quail Run Court, Albuquerque: a repairman saw McCasland at the house around 10am, his wife left at about 11:10am and returned at 12:04pm to find him gone, and she reported him missing at 3:07pm. He said the prescription glasses, a switched-off phone and a smartwatch were left behind, and that a red backpack, the wallet and a .38-calibre revolver with its holster were missing (0:05:16 to 0:06:12).
